Nothing in KAI's `*.md` design documents is a final spec, and
[`DESIGN_QUESTIONS.md`](../../DESIGN_QUESTIONS.md) already tracks known open
questions - check there first. A reasonable proposal may still remain
deferred even if accepted as reasonable; KAI 0.1's feature boundary is
deliberately narrow.

design/restriction actually block?):

**Proposed behavior:**

**Example KAI syntax:**

```kai

```

**Alternatives considered:**

**Compatibility implications** (does this change how existing valid programs
type-check or behave?):

**Safety/lifetime implications**, if relevant (e.g. interaction with slice
provenance, ownership, or bounds checking):

**Interaction with semantic tooling / AI-native goals**, if relevant (does
this affect `inspect`/`references`/`call-graph`, or the compiler's ability to
expose resolved semantic information)?
